```{r warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Calculation of risk ratios

rr <- ct_data |>
  select(sample_collection_dt, species, cnty_name, clinical_signs_, lab_diagnostics_pcr, rapid_diagnostic_test, sample_source) |>
  filter(!lab_diagnostics_pcr %in% "") |>
  group_by(species, clinical_signs_) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cases   = n(),
    rabies_positive = sum(lab_diagnostics_pcr == "Positive", na.rm=T),
    rabies_negative = sum(lab_diagnostics_pcr == "Negative", na.rm=T)) |>
     flextable::qflextable()
  
rr

table_2 <- ct_data |>
  select(sample_collection_dt, species, cnty_name, clinical_signs_, lab_diagnostics_pcr, rapid_diagnostic_test, sample_source) |>
  filter(!lab_diagnostics_pcr %in% "") |>
  group_by(species, clinical_signs_) |>
  dplyr::count() |>
  mutate(n = as.numeric(n)) |>
  pivot_wider( names_from = clinical_signs_, values_from = n
  ) |>
  mutate_at(c(2:14), as.numeric) |>
  mutate_at(vars(Anorexia:Rabid_animal_bite), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0)) |>
  adorn_totals("row") 


```




```{r, include=F}

reg_model <- glm(lab_diagnostics_pcr ~ clinical_signs_ + species + sample_source, family = "binomial", data = ct_data_)

summary(reg_model)


model1 <- glm(lab_diagnostics_pcr ~ clinical_signs_, family = "binomial", data = ct_data_)

model2 <- glm(lab_diagnostics_pcr ~ clinical_signs_ + species, family = "binomial", data = ct_data_)

lmtest::lrtest(model1, model2)

reg_model <- glm(lab_diagnostics_pcr ~ clinical_signs_ + species + sample_source, family = "binomial", data = ct_data_)

summary(reg_model)

## choose a model using forward selection based on AIC
## you can also do "backward" or "both" by adjusting the direction
final_reg_model <- reg_model %>%
  step(direction = "forward", trace = FALSE)

## show results table of final regression 
mv_tab <- tbl_regression(final_reg_model, exponentiate = F)

mv_tab

```

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.height=15, fig.width=20, warning=FALSE}

plot_data <- ct_data |>
  select(sample_collection_dt, species, bar_code, rapid_diagnostic_test, lab_diagnostics_pcr, clinical_signs_) |>
  filter(!lab_diagnostics_pcr %in% "") |>
  mutate(outcome_result =        ifelse(rapid_diagnostic_test==lab_diagnostics_pcr,"Yes","No")) |>
  mutate(test_result = case_when(
    rapid_diagnostic_test == "Positive" & outcome_result == "Yes" ~ "True_Positive",
    rapid_diagnostic_test == "Negative" & outcome_result == "Yes" ~ "True_Negative",
    lab_diagnostics_pcr == "Positive" & outcome_result == "No" ~ "False_Negative",
             TRUE ~ "False_Positive")) |>
  unique() |>
  mutate(classifications = case_when(
    test_result == "True_Positive" ~ 10,
    test_result == "True_Negative" ~ -10,
    test_result == "False_Positive" ~ 1,
    test_result == "False_Negative" ~ -1,
  )) |>
  mutate(FalseNegRate = 3 / (3+70),
         FalsePosRate = 4 / (4+8),
         TrueNegRate = 8 / (4+8),
         TruePosRate = 70 / (3+70)) |>
  mutate(rate = case_when(
      test_result ==  "True_Positive" ~ 0.9589041,
      test_result ==  "True_Negative" ~ 0.6666667,
      test_result ==  "False_Positive" ~ 0.3333333,
      test_result ==  "False_Negative" ~ 0.04109589,
  )) |>
  mutate(deviation = case_when(
      test_result ==  "True_Positive" ~ (1 - 0.9589041),
      test_result ==  "True_Negative" ~ (1 - 0.6666667),
      test_result ==  "False_Positive" ~ (1 - 0.3333333),
      test_result ==  "False_Negative" ~ (1- 0.04109589)))
  
# clinical signs vs test outcome

test <- plot_data <- ct_data |>
  select(sample_collection_dt, species, bar_code, rapid_diagnostic_test, lab_diagnostics_pcr,clinical_signs_ ) |>
  filter(!lab_diagnostics_pcr %in% "") |>
   mutate(outcome_result =        ifelse(rapid_diagnostic_test==lab_diagnostics_pcr,"Yes","No")) |>
  mutate(test_result = case_when(
    rapid_diagnostic_test == "Positive" & outcome_result == "Yes" ~ "True_Positive",
    rapid_diagnostic_test == "Negative" & outcome_result == "Yes" ~ "True_Negative",
    lab_diagnostics_pcr == "Positive" & outcome_result == "No" ~ "False_Negative",
             TRUE ~ "False_Positive")) |>
  mutate(lab_diagnostics_pcr_ = recode(lab_diagnostics_pcr, 
             "Positive" = "1",
             "Negative" = "0")) |>
  mutate(lab_diagnostics_pcr_ = as.factor(lab_diagnostics_pcr_)) |>
  mutate(clinical_signs_ = as.factor(clinical_signs_)) |>
  mutate(test_result = as.factor(test_result)) 

#Correlation between Clinical Signs and RDT Test Result

corr_rdt_cs <- ggplot(test, aes(x = clinical_signs_, fill = test_result)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") + 
  labs(
    x = "Clinical Signs",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "RDT Result") +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_flip()+
  theme(text=element_text(size=20))

#Correlation between Clinical Signs and PCR Test Result

corr_pcr_cs <- ggplot(test, aes(x = clinical_signs_, fill = lab_diagnostics_pcr)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") + 
  labs(
    x = "Clinical Signs",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "PCR Result") +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_flip()+
  theme(text=element_text(size=20))

plot1 <-ggarrange(corr_rdt_cs, corr_pcr_cs,nrow = 1, labels = c("A", "B"),
  font.label = list(size = 20,color = "black", align ="hv"))

plot1
```

# GLM

```{r, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}

model_glm <- ct_data |>
   select(sample_collection_dt, species, cnty_name, sample_source, lab_diagnostics_pcr, rapid_diagnostic_test, clinical_signs_) |>
  filter(!lab_diagnostics_pcr %in% "") |>
  group_by(sample_collection_dt, species, cnty_name, sample_source, lab_diagnostics_pcr, rapid_diagnostic_test, clinical_signs_) |>
  count() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from=clinical_signs_, values_from=n) |>
  mutate_at(vars(aggressive:Abnormal_vocalization), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0)) |>
   mutate(lab_diagnostics_pcr = recode(lab_diagnostics_pcr, 
             "Positive" = "1",
             "Negative" = "0")) |>
  mutate(lab_diagnostics_pcr = as.numeric(lab_diagnostics_pcr))


model1 <- glm(lab_diagnostics_pcr ~ aggressive , family = "binomial", data = model_glm)

summary(model1)

model2 <- glm(lab_diagnostics_pcr ~ biting_objects , family = "binomial", data = model_glm)

summary(model2)

model3 <- glm(lab_diagnostics_pcr ~ excessive_salivation, family = binomial(link = 'logit'), data = model_glm)

summary(model3)

model4 <- glm(lab_diagnostics_pcr ~ running_aimlessly, family = binomial(link = 'logit'), data = model_glm)

summary(model4)

model5 <- glm(lab_diagnostics_pcr ~ biting_objects + aggressive , family = "binomial", data = model_glm)

summary(model5)

saturated_model <- glm(lab_diagnostics_pcr ~ aggressive + biting_objects + excessive_salivation + hydrophobia + running_aimlessly + high_libido + Rabid_animal_bite + paralysis + Anorexia + Diarrhoea + groaning + Abnormal_vocalization, family = binomial(link = 'logit'), data = model_glm)

summary(saturated_model)

# Looking at the interaction between variables that reported high clinical signs

interactive_model <- glm(lab_diagnostics_pcr ~ aggressive * biting_objects * excessive_salivation, family = binomial(link = 'logit'), data = model_glm)

summary(interactive_model)


interactive_model2 <- glm(lab_diagnostics_pcr ~ aggressive * excessive_salivation, family = binomial(link = 'logit'), data = model_glm)

summary(interactive_model2)

```
